levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Statements still include a justification or self-judgment clause explaining why the need exists.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Statements name the need plainly in one sentence with no justification or self-judgment attached.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Statements are plain and also specific enough that another person would know exactly what kind of help is being asked for.

criteria.dimension: Relevance to the learner's actual plan

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Named needs are generic and don't clearly connect to the learner's own transition plan.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two named needs clearly connect to a specific part of the learner's own plan.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Named needs cover more than one type of support (for example, logistical and emotional), showing a realistic, varied picture of what the transition will require.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection doesn't distinguish naming from justifying, or restates the question without an answer.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection clearly explains the difference between naming and justifying a need.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection connects that difference to a real effect on how others might respond to the request.

lookFors: No specific private health, financial, or family detail is required or given — general categories are enough.
Statements read as neutral requests, not apologies or confessions.
The learner engages with the actual practice example rather than skipping straight to their own list.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
